selection: Five Packagist-ranked paths have passed valid controls: seld/jsonlint (252,371,311 downloads), laminas/laminas-json (35,102,503, forced own PHP Decoder), halaxa/json-machine (30,443,415, own stream Parser plus ext/json member decoding), salsify/json-streaming-parser (7,715,575, own character state machine with listener events), and pcrov/jsonreader (1,520,757, own pull lexer/state machine).
uncertainty: Five PHP JSON third-party paths passed valid nested object controls and source-line coverage. Laminas, JSON Machine, salsify and pcrov also passed a valid nested array control and stable source-line AFL feedback. Laminas is abandoned, and its own decoder runs only when explicitly enabled; its default API route delegates to ext/json. JSON Machine shares ext/json for member decoding. salsify accepts only object/array roots and silently accepts concatenated documents, so its harness rejects anything other than one complete document; the tree-building listener is harness code. Two own-parser or partial-own-parser leads remain unverified; five json_decode wrappers are excluded, including colinodell/json5 on both valid controls. pcrov/jsonreader has a separate lexer and state machine, with three parser-source features and AFL tuples differing between the valid controls. The bounded search used five Packagist queries of at most 100 hits each. Package downloads measure overall/historical adoption, not JSON parsing frequency. Valid controls do not establish complete RFC 8259 support.
